 Jaylen Waddle's status uncertain
 Ryan Dodson, USA TODAY 2026년 10월 28일 수 오후 3:04 UTC 0 Denver Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) aggravated a chest injury in Week 7, and his status for Week 8 is unknown, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport . 
 Advertisement
 Why it Matters: Waddle has just 10 catches for 91 yards over the last three weeks in what has been a miserable first half-season in his Broncos tenure. If he's able to go, he's merely a flex option against the Kansas City Chiefs. If he can't go, Marvin Mims Jr. receives a boost into flex territory.
